HowItWorks.subtitle: How It Works
HowItWorks.title: Your Journey in 4 Simple Steps
HowItWorks.description: We've made booking a Mathura Vrindavan tour as easy as possible so you can focus on what matters — your spiritual experience.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Browse our curated tour packages — 1 day to 8 days. Filter by car type, duration, and budget. Everything is clearly priced, no hidden charges.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Fill in your travel details, select add-ons like hotel help or a local guide. Pay securely online or choose to pay on arrival.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Your verified, experienced driver arrives at your location on time with a clean, AC vehicle ready for your spiritual journey.
HowItWorks.step4Desc: Immerse yourself in the divine energy of Braj Bhoomi. Our drivers know every temple, every shortcut, every aarti timing.

WhyChooseUs.subtitle: Why Choose Us
WhyChooseUs.title: The Most Trusted Tour Partner in Braj
WhyChooseUs.description: Thousands of devotees have trusted us with their most sacred journeys. Here's what makes us different.
WhyChooseUs.f1Desc: Choose from Swift, Eeco, Ertiga, Innova and more — all AC, GPS-equipped, well-maintained vehicles with experienced drivers.
WhyChooseUs.f2Desc: What you see is what you pay. No hidden charges, no surprises. All-inclusive pricing from ₹2,000 onwards.
WhyChooseUs.f3Desc: Our drivers and guides are born and raised in Braj. They know every temple story, every shortcut, every aarti timing.
WhyChooseUs.f4Desc: Need a place to stay or eat? We help you find the best pure-veg restaurants and budget-to-premium hotels in Mathura & Vrindavan.
WhyChooseUs.f5Desc: Our team is always available on call and WhatsApp. Any issue during your trip — we solve it immediately.
WhyChooseUs.f6Desc: All our drivers are police-verified, licensed, and trained in safe driving. Your safety is our highest priority.
WhyChooseUs.f7Desc: We help arrange special pujas, Yamuna aarti participation, temple VIP passes, and spiritual guide services.
WhyChooseUs.f8Desc: Plans changed? Cancel up to 24 hours before your trip for a full refund. No questions asked.
